design.objective: Keep production baselines viewable while preventing any result maintenance before the owning window reaches productionEnd.
users: Production managers reviewing and maintaining production-baseline results

requirements.statement: Window options show status, production end time and an unavailable reason while remaining selectable.
acceptance: Unfinished options show a reason and load their baseline

requirements.statement: All frontend maintenance controls are unavailable before the selected window ends while data stays visible.
acceptance: Selection, single and batch maintenance are disabled
A page reason shows the opening time

requirements.statement: The boundary is now greater than or equal to productionEnd in Asia/Shanghai.
Single and batch APIs enforce the owning window end time without client eligibility claims.
The rule covers all version types without changing result semantics, locking or audit.

constraints: Use Vue 3, Element Plus and Clock patterns

selected_approach.name: Frontend guidance plus server-enforced window gate
selected_approach.reason: Immediate feedback plus non-bypassable integrity without contract expansion.

components.name: ReleaseBaselineView
components.responsibility: Show reasons and disable all maintenance before productionEnd.

components.name: ReleaseProductionService
components.responsibility: Enforce tenant window productionEnd before writes.

components.name: ReleaseProductionServiceTest
components.responsibility: Verify boundaries, no-write rejection and regressions.

interfaces.name: Window eligibility
interfaces.contract: productionEnd controls maintenance while viewing remains allowed.

interfaces.name: Result gate
interfaces.contract: Tenant window exists and now is not before productionEnd.

data_flows.output: Conflict without writes or maintained result

error_handling.behavior: CONFLICT with end time and no writes.

error_handling.recovery: Refresh and retry after server boundary.

performance: One indexed lookup per entry under 200 limit

verification_strategy.signal: Fixed-clock tests cover denial, boundary and regression.
Dropdown and controls match window time while data stays visible.

assumptions.text: Client and server clocks are normally close.

approval.evidence: The user reviewed the landed design and explicitly requested development.
